text: Theo’s quiet contemplation of the night sky was not merely a pastime but a profound connection to his late mother, an astrophysicist who had nurtured his early curiosity about the universe. From the rooftop of their rural home, he spent countless nights charting constellations, seeking answers in the stars that his mother had once loved. This deep-seated bond drove his current actions, as he sought to understand the cosmos in her honor. Meanwhile, on the ground below, the world operated on simpler, more immediate cycles; rain fell from the fluffy things in the sky, a gentle reminder of the earthly rhythms that continued regardless of the celestial mysteries Theo pursued.
